description: Compare a set of MBS items for one occasion with the rules written in their descriptors, as schedule reference information: pairs the schedule says are not claimable together, time tiers met or missed, flags for assistant, anaesthetic and hospital-only items, and the multiple operation rule for Group T8 items with the resulting total of schedule fees (a schedule figure, not a patient charge). It reports what the descriptors say and never drops an item; it does not decide what should be billed. Rules the schedule words in ways that are not coded, such as exempt items, are not checked.

durations.description: Minutes the service lasted, only for items whose descriptor has a time tier.

item_number.description: An MBS item number, 1 to 6 digits, for example 30445.

item_numbers.description: The items performed on one occasion, 1 to 15 item numbers.
